mappings.title: How We Connect — Communication Preferences & Rules

element_mappings.title_text: How We Connect — Communication Preferences & Rules
element_mappings.left_content:
💬 Slack/Teams: Quick info exchange
🗣️ Face-to-Face/Call: Complex & misunderstood topics
📧 Email: Official decisions & 3rd party
element_mappings.right_content:
📌 Context Upfront: Provide background unless mutual understanding exists.
⚡ Single-Threading: Handle only one live call/F2F conversation at a time.
element_mappings.banner_content: 1. Context (facts only) ➔ 2. Problem definition ➔ 3. Proposed solutions (if any)

mappings.title: Inside the Engine — Default Behaviors & Quirks

element_mappings.title_text: Inside the Engine — Default Behaviors & Quirks
element_mappings.card1_desc: Brainstorm and jump between ideas out loud before focusing on final solution.
element_mappings.card2_desc: Easily irritated when things get incoherent; sort them out before moving on.
element_mappings.card3_desc: More energetic on product & engineering topics; lower energy in other areas.
element_mappings.card4_desc: Love to build and run product discovery at the same time.

mappings.title: Rules of Engagement — Pet Peeves & Golden Rules

element_mappings.title_text: Rules of Engagement — Pet Peeves & Golden Rules
element_mappings.left_content:
• Unscheduled communication for non-urgent matters.
• Refusal of ideas/proposals without clear reasons.
element_mappings.right_content:
• Notify me beforehand for synchronous check-ins.
• Give reasons for idea refusal & suggest alternatives.
